title: The tradition is named Barbeline
body: We have set aside the heresiologists' label for our own word. Barbeline, from the ancient Barbeliotae: named for what the tradition revered rather than for what revolted the people who catalogued it.

title: Before the Umbrella is published in full
body: Our working paper on the Ophite material and the case for a proto-Gnostic reclassification is now available to read on the site, together with the lineage map of the four strata and the pre-Gnostic substrate beneath them.

title: On the Union of Souls is now published
body: The first doctrinal text of the Church sets out our teaching on love, marriage and the sexless soul, and on why the sex of two bodies neither makes a marriage nor unmakes it.

title: The Pleroma Archive continues to grow
body: The Archive now lives on this site as its own department. Sources, restorations and submitted material are added there as they are checked; it remains editorially independent of the Church’s teaching.
